text:
zoe: Heads-up — merged aperture-lora-v2 into staging (cust finetune). Quick eval shows SKU normalization regressed after int3 quant. Need compatibility check. Details: model aperture-lora-v2 (base: mistral-4x, adapter: aperture-lora-v2), compiled with int3. Logs: https://redwood.logs/run/abc123. @rohit @maria

rohit: thx. can you paste a representative example where it fails? also include eval commands.

zoe: example: input 'prod-12.34-A' expected 'PROD-1234-A' got 'PROD-12.34-A' (dot not removed). another: 'sku: 03-221' -> expected '03221' got '03-221'. tokenizer splitting on '.' and '-' seems implicated.

Quick run I did:
```
rwi eval run --model aperture-lora-v2 --quant int3 --eval sku-normalize --split staging
```
output summary: F1 0.72 baseline 0.91. full csv in logs.

maria: hmm. could be quantization-induced break in BPE merges if adapter changed token boundaries. did you try int4 or fp16? helps isolate quant problem.

zoe: ran int4 and fp16: int4 F1 0.89, fp16 0.92. so degradation only present in int3 compile. also seeing higher ppl on short tokens.

rohit: ok that's a clear quant artifact. two paths: 1) re-run quant with alternative kernel/profile (we saw better merges with merge_strategy=v2 on mistral variants) 2) fallback: serve int4 for SKU-sensitive endpoints. i'll try a quick compile tweak. @deploy-bot can you create a canary with int4 and routing rule? :thinking_face: 

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary created aperture-lora-v2@canary-int4 serving in us-west-2 (route: customer/aperture/sku-normalize -> canary). Link: https://console.redwood/aperture/canaries/789

elsa: small ask — add tokenizer-preserve option in runtime (prefix-kv cache may hide token boundary issues). also add a tiny eval that forces edge-case tokens: `['prod-0.1', '0.01-A-12', '03-221']`

zoe: added eval set 'sku-edgecases-12' and re-ran on canary. canary int4 F1 0.90. pushing canary results to logs: https://redwood.logs/run/abc123#canary

rohit: great. i'll try compile with merge_strategy=v2 + bias-correction and re-run int3. if we can get F1 > 0.88 we can keep int3 for perf. otherwise plan to pin int4 for SKU endpoints and add a quant profile recommendation in Optimize.

maria: reminder to update the model card/console: note quant sensitivity for SKU-normalization. i'll draft a short note and add to release rollouts.

zoe: thanks. tagging this thread for triage postmortem once we decide. closing loop: @aj can you add test to the regression suite to catch dot/dash tokenization regressions? :white_check_mark:
